office_does: The part-time District Court judge hears misdemeanors, traffic infractions, small claims, protection orders and smaller civil cases, and fills in for the full-time judge.
race_blurb: Open seat: part-time Judge Jared Hawkins is moving to the full-time bench. Former deputy prosecutor and defense attorney Nicholas Holce, who lost this race to Hawkins in 2022, faces attorney and superior court judge pro tem Janelle Carman-Wagner.

candidates.summary: Walla Walla criminal and appellate defense attorney, a county deputy prosecutor from 2013 to 2020, who has served as a judge pro tempore.
highlights: Deputy prosecuting attorney 2013-2020; criminal defense since 2020, appellate defense since 2025 [S2]
Has served as judge pro tempore in superior and district court [S2]
Wants a district court engaged with employment, housing and treatment pathways [S5]
Lost the 2022 race for this seat to Jared Hawkins [S3]

safety.basis: Emphasizes treatment courts and connecting defendants with employment and housing as the way to improve justice; documented from his own statements in 2022 and 2026.

candidates.summary: Owner of Carman Law Office since 2005 and a former Assistant Attorney General, appointed a superior court judge pro tempore more than 20 times since 2015.
highlights: Civil, family, administrative and criminal practice since 2005; Assistant Attorney General 2001-2005 [S2][S3]
Superior court judge pro tem since 2015 and district court pro tem in 2026 [S2][S3]
Says the biggest change is to 'really hold people accountable' with substantive treatment [S5]

safety.basis: Leads with accountability ('the biggest change we can make is to really hold people accountable'), using court-mandated treatment rather than 'superficial' programs.
